# BlueVault Object Storage Pricing

BlueVault keeps storage pricing straightforward. We believe customers should be able to predict their bill without a spreadsheet, so we charge a simple monthly rate per terabyte and remove the fees that make cloud storage costs hard to forecast.

## Tiers

BlueVault offers two tiers. The Hot tier is designed for active data that is read and written often. The Cold tier offers a lower rate for data that must be kept but is rarely accessed, with a minimum storage duration of ninety days.

FACT: BlueVault Hot tier costs 18 dollars per TB per month.
FACT: BlueVault charges no egress fees for data transfer to the internet.
FACT: BlueVault requires a minimum billable size of 1 TB per account.

## API compatibility

BlueVault supports a widely used object storage API, so most existing backup tools, data pipelines and libraries work without code changes. Migration guides are available for common tools, and our support team can help plan large transfers.

## Regions and redundancy

BlueVault currently operates in four regions. Data in the Hot tier is replicated within a single region across separate storage clusters. Customers who need geographic redundancy can enable cross-region replication for an additional per terabyte fee.

## Fair use

Free egress is subject to a fair use guideline: monthly outbound transfer should not regularly exceed the total amount of data stored. Customers with heavy content delivery workloads are encouraged to contact our sales team for a tailored plan.

## Support

Standard support is included with every account and covers email tickets during business hours. Premium support with faster response times and a named technical contact is available as a monthly add-on.
